nodes.title: Your speech (wav/mp3, one voice, up to 9 s)
Prompt (what the scene looks like)
widgets_values: A person talks to the camera with natural facial expressions and small head movements.

nodes.title: Long side in px (832 = Wan 480p size)
Steps (6 = what the speed LoRA needs)
Why three parts
widgets_values: **Why parts:** InfiniteTalk makes 81 frames (3.24 s at 25 fps) per pass. Each next part starts from the last 9 frames so far and the speech from that point on.

widgets_values_named.text: **Why parts:** InfiniteTalk makes 81 frames (3.24 s at 25 fps) per pass. Each next part starts from the last 9 frames so far and the speech from that point on.

nodes.title: Why the trim
widgets_values: **Why the trim:** a part that continues the video starts with the 9 frames it was given. `trim_image` drops them, so no frames repeat and the lips stay on the speech. (The template joins them untrimmed.)

nodes.title: How to use · v1.0.0
widgets_values:
## How to use · v1.0.0

**What it does:** makes a talking video from one picture and a speech clip with InfiniteTalk on Wan 2.1 (lips, face and head follow the voice). Core ComfyUI nodes only.

1. **Your inputs** (green group):
   - **Your picture**: one person, face visible. It is set to `example.png` (ships with ComfyUI) so the box is never empty.
   - **Your speech**: one voice, up to 9 s (three parts x about 3 s). Upload your own clip; the name in the box is the lab's test clip, which you do not have.
   - **Prompt**: describe the scene and the person in English. Keep it short.
   - **Long side** (832): the video keeps the picture's shape; 832 px on the long side is Wan 2.1's 480p size (1368x768 picture → 832x464 video).
   - **Lip-sync strength** (1): how strongly the speech moves the mouth.
   - **Steps** (6): the lightx2v speed LoRA is made for few steps at CFG 1.
   - **Seed**: fixed at 24112026. Type a new number for another take.
2. **Models**: the six loaders must show the files from the Downloads note.
3. **Prompt, speech, size, sampler**: nothing to change.
4. to 6. **Parts 1-3**: each part makes about 3 s and continues the one before. The video is always 9.0 s: shorter speech ends in quiet video, longer speech needs more parts (below).
7. Press **Run**. The video (with your speech) is saved by **Result** to `output/InfiniteTalk/`.

**Longer speech:** select group 6, copy it (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Shift+V), link **Join parts 1-3** into the new part's `previous_frames` and the new **Join**'s `image0`, then link the new **Join** to **Frames + speech → video**. Each part adds 72 frames (2.9 s).

**What to expect:** a 9.0 s video at 25 fps with your speech, 832x464 for a 16:9 picture. On an RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB one video took 13 min 43 s to 14 min 1 s (sampling: 3 min 40 s to 4 min 22 s per part, about 43 s per step).

**Tested on:** ComfyUI 0.45.3, RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB: four full runs with two pictures and the lab's 8 s speech clip. Not verified on a 12 GB card.

nodes.title: Downloads + requirements
widgets_values:
## Downloads + requirements

Click the file name to download it. Put each file in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

| Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | [wan2.1_i2v_480p_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.1/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.1_i2v_480p_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors) | 16.4 GB |
| `loras/` | [lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank64_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/resolve/main/Lightx2v/lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank64_bf16.safetensors) | 0.74 GB |
| `model_patches/` | [wan2.1_infiniteTalk_single_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.1/resolve/main/split_files/model_patches/wan2.1_infiniteTalk_single_fp16.safetensors) | 5.13 GB |
| `audio_encoders/` | [wav2vec2-chinese-base_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/wav2vec2_safetensors/resolve/main/wav2vec2-chinese-base_fp16.safetensors) | 0.19 GB |
| `text_encoders/` | [umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.1/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors) | 6.74 GB |
| `vae/` | [wan_2.1_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.1/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors) | 0.25 GB |

The template links Kijai's `Wan2_1-I2V-14B-480p_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled_KJ` and `Wan2_1_VAE_bf16`; this workflow uses the Comfy-Org copies above. If you already have the Kijai files, pick them in the loaders.

**VRAM:** Not verified on 12 GB. On the 24 GB test card the ComfyUI process took 22.3 GiB with no limit. Started with a 12 GiB budget it used 13.1 to 13.2 GiB, with a 10 GiB budget 11.3 GiB (12.2 GiB for the whole GPU), at the same speed. The 14B model file is 16.4 GB, so on a 12 GB card part of it stays in system RAM.

**Run on ComfyUI 0.45.3.** **No custom nodes.**

Licence: Apache-2.0 (InfiniteTalk, Wan 2.1, lightx2v LoRA); MIT (chinese-wav2vec2-base).
